**Feedback on Your Warrior One Pose:**

*"Great effort in your Warrior One pose! You’re building a strong foundation, and with a few adjustments, you’ll feel even more stable and powerful. Let’s refine a few key points together:*

1. **Spine Alignment:** *Your spine isn’t fully straight—try to lengthen through the crown of your head while keeping your chest lifted. Imagine a string pulling you gently upward from the top of your head. This will help you avoid collapsing into your lower back and keep your posture strong.*

2. **Arms Position:** *Your arms aren’t fully extended upward. Reach your fingertips toward the sky, keeping your shoulders relaxed and away from your ears. Engage your core to support this lift, creating a beautiful, elongated line from your hips to your hands.*

3. **Knee Placement:** *Your front knee isn’t directly over your ankle—this can strain your joint. Adjust your stance so your knee stacks right above your ankle, forming a 90-degree angle. This will protect your knee and give you a solid base.*

*Take a deep breath, reset, and try these adjustments. Remember, yoga is about progress, not perfection. You’re doing great—keep listening to your body and refining your alignment. Let’s try it again together!"*

*(Demonstrate or guide them through the corrections if possible.)*

**Encouragement:** *"Every small adjustment brings you closer to strength and balance. I can already see your dedication—keep it up!"*
